transform_layout: instances are [px, py, pz, rx, ry, rz, sx, sy, sz]
trees_note: LOD is pre-assigned (no runtime switching): for each tree type draw bark + leaves at every 'near' transform and the lod1 mesh at every 'far' transform. 'near' = within 100 m of the camera path.

SM_Forge_Building.note: Walls, floor, gables, timber frame, door/window frames. Origin at floor centre.

SM_Forge_Roof.note: Gable roof with rafters. Origin at floor centre of the building.

SM_Door_L.note: Door leaf, pivot = hinge axis at floor. Rotate about +Y (up) to open inward: negative angle in glTF space.

SM_Door_R.note: Door leaf, pivot = hinge axis at floor. Rotate about +Y (up) to open inward: positive angle in glTF space.

SM_Window_Shutters.note: Static open shutters. Placed on the outside of the +X wall.

SM_Forge_Hearth.note: Forge hearth. Origin at floor below hearth centre. Coal bed surface at local z=0.740, pot 0.75x0.55 m. Tuyere enters from -X at z=0.770.

SM_Forge_Hood.note: Hood + chimney. Origin = hearth centre at floor. Chimney top is a good smoke emitter point.

SM_Coal_A.note: Coal piece for instancing. Emissive map = ember cracks; scale its intensity in the shader for the glow animation.

SM_Coal_B.note: Coal piece for instancing. Emissive map = ember cracks; scale its intensity in the shader for the glow animation.

SM_Coal_C.note: Coal piece for instancing. Emissive map = ember cracks; scale its intensity in the shader for the glow animation.

SM_Bellows_Bottom.note: Bellows bottom board + nozzle. Static. Origin = hinge axis.

SM_Bellows_Top.note: Bellows top board (open pose = rotated 12.0 deg up about the hinge). Exported closed (flat). Origin = hinge axis. Rotate about local Blender -Y (glTF +Z) to open. Handle bar at the wide end is where the smith pushes.

SM_Bellows_Leather.note: Bellows leather in the OPEN pose. Origin = hinge axis. To close, scale local Blender Z (glTF Y) toward 0 together with the top board rotation (scaleY = tan(angle)/tan(open_angle)).

SM_Anvil.note: Anvil. Origin = bottom centre. Working face at local z=0.38 (Blender) / y=0.38 (glTF).

SM_Stump.note: Anvil stump. Origin = bottom centre, height 0.55 m.

SM_Hammer.note: Hammer. Origin = grip point at the bottom of the handle; handle along local +Z (Blender) / +Y (glTF); striking face points +X.

SM_Tongs.note: Tongs, origin at the rivet, jaws toward +X.

SM_Workpiece.note: Hot iron bar, 45 cm. Emissive map is the heat gradient (hot middle). Origin = bottom centre. Multiply emissive by a heat value to cool it down.

SM_QuenchTub.note: Half-barrel quench tub. Origin = bottom centre.

SM_QuenchWater.note: Water surface disc for the quench tub (put your ripple shader here). Origin = centre of the surface.

SM_WoodPile.note: Small pile of split logs, fits under the hearth.

SM_Workbench.note: Workbench, long side along X. Origin = floor centre.

SM_ToolRack.note: Wall rack with iron pegs. Origin = centre of the board, pegs toward -Y.

SM_Pelt.note: Hide for shell-textured fur. Origin = top nail, front faces -Y (Blender) / +Z (glTF). Extrude shells along the vertex normal.

SM_Terrain.note: Terrain 900 x 900 m, origin at world centre. Forge sits at the origin.

SM_River_Water.note: River water ribbon at world height -1.3 (Blender z). Origin = world origin.

SM_House_A.note: Village house variant A (7.0 x 5.0 m). Origin = ground centre, front door toward -Y.

SM_House_B.note: Village house variant B (8.5 x 5.5 m). Origin = ground centre, front door toward -Y.

SM_House_C.note: Village house variant C (5.0 x 4.0 m). Origin = ground centre, front door toward -Y.

SM_Tree_Pine_A_LOD1.note: Low-poly far LOD of Pine_A (~15.0 m), single mesh. Origin = trunk base.

SM_Tree_Pine_B_LOD1.note: Low-poly far LOD of Pine_B (~19.0 m), single mesh. Origin = trunk base.

SM_Tree_Oak_A_LOD1.note: Low-poly far LOD of Oak_A (~12.0 m), single mesh. Origin = trunk base.

SM_Tree_Oak_B_LOD1.note: Low-poly far LOD of Oak_B (~9.5 m), single mesh. Origin = trunk base.

SM_Tree_Oak_A_Bark.note: Tree Oak_A branches (12.0 m). Origin = trunk base. Pair with SM_Tree_Oak_A_Leaves at the same transform.

SM_Tree_Oak_A_Leaves.note: Tree Oak_A foliage cards. Alpha MASK (cutoff 0.5), double sided, normals point out of the crown. Draw with alpha test / discard.

SM_Tree_Oak_B_Bark.note: Tree Oak_B branches (9.5 m). Origin = trunk base. Pair with SM_Tree_Oak_B_Leaves at the same transform.

SM_Tree_Oak_B_Leaves.note: Tree Oak_B foliage cards. Alpha MASK (cutoff 0.5), double sided, normals point out of the crown. Draw with alpha test / discard.

SM_Tree_Pine_A_Bark.note: Tree Pine_A branches (15.0 m). Origin = trunk base. Pair with SM_Tree_Pine_A_Leaves at the same transform.

SM_Tree_Pine_A_Leaves.note: Tree Pine_A foliage cards. Alpha MASK (cutoff 0.5), double sided, normals point out of the crown. Draw with alpha test / discard.

SM_Tree_Pine_B_Bark.note: Tree Pine_B branches (19.0 m). Origin = trunk base. Pair with SM_Tree_Pine_B_Leaves at the same transform.

SM_Tree_Pine_B_Leaves.note: Tree Pine_B foliage cards. Alpha MASK (cutoff 0.5), double sided, normals point out of the crown. Draw with alpha test / discard.

markers.name: FX_AnvilStrike
markers.note: Where the hammer hits the hot bar: spark emitter, slow-motion focus.

markers.name: FX_CoalBed
markers.note: Centre of the glowing coal bed: forge light, ember sparks, heat cloud shader.

markers.name: FX_DustVolume
markers.note: Interior dust volume, box half extents.

markers.name: SMITH_Bellows
markers.note: Bellows smith stands here facing +Y (Blender) / -Z (glTF). Hands on the handle bar of SM_Bellows_Top.

markers.name: SMITH_Hammer
markers.note: Hammer smith behind the anvil facing the door (-Y Blender / +Z glTF).

lights.name: Sun
lights.note: Low evening sun from behind the camera's left, golden hour.
